recordedAtUtcSource: date -u, read from the shell when this decision was written

defect.assumption: the generic next-window planner and the history replay assumed that a window begins with zero already-assigned-but-unexecuted replacements
defect.planner: buildGeneration2WindowSpec made the replacement members exactly the NEW complete-Q1 assignments, so an assigned, unexecuted occupant was silently left out of the next window
defect.replay: replayWindow refused HISTORY_UNEXECUTED_ASSIGNMENT whenever any slot was still ASSIGNED at the start of a window
defect.window09State: correct as adjudicated; it is not altered: slot 99 stays REPLACEMENT_ASSIGNED_AWAITING_EXECUTION, occupied by Generation-2 reserve 12 at ledger sequence 12

semantics.CURRENT_ACQUISITION_FAILURE: the slot needs a NEW replacement assignment (a Q1 obligation)
semantics.REPLACEMENT_ASSIGNED_AWAITING_EXECUTION: the slot ALREADY has its replacement occupant in the canonical ledger
semantics.windowReplacementMembership: carry-in assigned replacements + new complete-Q1 replacements
semantics.replacementGroupOrder: canonical ledger-assignment sequence ascending; independent of slot number and of the window that created the assignment
semantics.cadence: may move the complete replacement group before or after the primaries; never alters its membership or its internal ledger order
semantics.windowSize: every current replacement execution obligation (carry-in + complete Q1) must fit; otherwise the planner fails closed before planning primaries (REPLACEMENT_OBLIGATIONS_EXCEED_WINDOW); primaries fill only the remaining places
semantics.ledgerConsumption: unchanged: a pre-network append consumes its sequences whether or not their work items are later executed; ledger consumption and replacement execution/adjudication stay distinct concepts
semantics.q1: unchanged: the ascending current failures not yet assigned
semantics.ledgerAppend: unchanged: exactly the new complete-Q1 assignments
semantics.p7: unchanged eighteen invariants; completeQ1EqualsPlanningQ1, plannedReplacementAppendRecorded and noUnexpectedGeneration2Assignments still concern ONLY the new append; postAppendOccupantsMatchAssignedReserves covers every replacement work item including carry-in; workItemsMatchGovernance requires every carry-in and every planned Q1 replacement as members, in ledger-sequence order

doesNotChange: the reserve assignment policy or order
the cadence vocabulary or the default cadence
identityDisclosure: slot numbers, reserve positions, ledger sequences, work item ids, digests and aggregates only; no organisation id, echeRowKey, URL, hostname or page text
immutability: append-only. This record is never edited; a correction is a new record
